punchline: Tesla, SpaceX, LinkedIn and Palantir all trace back to the people at one small startup.
thirty_sec: Peter Thiel lists what PayPal's alumni went on to start or build: Tesla, SpaceX, LinkedIn, Palantir, YouTube, Yelp and Yammer. He doesn't call it luck. He points to the first team: people who were talented and who wanted to work together, each with a clearly defined job so nobody fought for the same turf. A startup that's flawed at its foundation, he says, can't be fixed later. The list can't prove the hiring caused all that, though.
